name: Shop
description: Searches Shopify merchants for whatever you're after and comes back with a handful of candidates, each with a link to complete the purchase. Shipping destination is confirmed on every request and nothing is bought until you say so, which suits people who dislike stored defaults.

official.title: Shop by Alex
official.description: Finds products across Shopify and shortlists a few options with checkout links. Asks where to ship each time, and never spends without your approval.
